name: British American Tobacco (Malaysia) Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项，公告主要为季度业绩、股息派发、股东常年大会及与关联方的经常性交易授权续期。最新一季（2026年9月30日止）营收同比下跌51.7%，净利润同比下跌95.4%。
overview_en: The company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction or divestment of business segments this year; announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividend declarations, annual general meeting matters and renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue fell 51.7% year-on-year and net profit fell 95.4% year-on-year.
